annotations.text:
Direction B · Karkhana — ink on paper.
Paper #F6F5F0 · ink #111111 · marigold #E2A100 (one accent, used only for the thing to do next) · hairlines 1px, structure 2px, no radius, no shadows.
Type: Archivo 900 for display (uppercase, tight), Archivo 500/700 for body, IBM Plex Mono for labels/IDs/prices-in-tables, Noto Sans Devanagari for Hindi.
Every tap target ≥ 44px. Pattern blocks stand in for photos.
Storefront: Home → Shop listing → Product page → /sell.

Seller portal in the same grammar. Every screen has a read-aloud button (सुनें) and a language switch in the top bar; sidebar items carry Hindi under English.
Add product is the showpiece: the three AI tools run down the left in order — Studio (with retake coaching in Hindi), Describe by voice (transcript → generated listing → read back to confirm), Price (cost inputs → floor/fair/premium → the comparables it came from, explained in Hindi). The plain form sits on the right and is pre-filled by the tools.
Kept for reference: the two unchosen sketches. Anything here can still be folded into B (e.g. C's one-colour-per-job tiles).
